instruction:
The required CAE handoff spans two applications: SolidWorks -> Abaqus/CAE. Use the SOLIDWORKS 2025 and Abaqus CAE shortcuts on the desktop for the two stages of this workflow. Start from a new blank SolidWorks part and use N-mm-MPa units.

Handoff requirement: preserve EW_SW_ABQ_04 and SOLIDWORKS_TO_ABAQUS in the SolidWorks STEP text, and preserve EW_SW_ABQ_04 and IMPORTED_FROM_stage1_geometry.step in a native Abaqus name or job description.

1. In SolidWorks, create one connected 8 mm thick lug plate. In XY, union the rectangle 0<=X<=77.5 mm, 0<=Y<=45 mm with a R22.5 mm circular lug end centered at (77.5,22.5) mm; the finished outline spans X=0 to 100 mm. Cut the D18 pin bore at (77.5,22.5) mm and two D6 root mounting holes at (15,12) and (15,33) mm, all through Z=0 to 8 mm. Export C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1_geometry.step.
2. Import the STEP into Model-LugBearing. Define Steel with E=210000 MPa and nu=0.3, assign a homogeneous solid section, and use a coarse first-order C3D4/C3D8R mesh with no quadratic elements and no more than 1000 nodes. Create ROOT_HOLES from both D6 cylindrical faces, PIN_BORE from the D18 cylindrical face, and PIN_BORE_SURFACE from that face. Create Static, General step Step-Bearing. Apply BC-RootHoles with U1=U2=U3=0. Create a reference point at (77.5,22.5,4) mm, connect it to PIN_BORE_SURFACE with distributing coupling Coupling-PinBore, and apply Load-PinBearing as CF1=+2000 N at the reference point. Submit Job-LugBearing and wait for completion.
3. Required Desktop deliverables: stage1_geometry.step, Job-LugBearing.cae, and Job-LugBearing.odb. Do not create extra STEP, DXF, CAE, or ODB deliverables.
